current_profile_snapshot.groove_behavior: slow swing, rubato or straight ballad feel; pulse can soften at phrase edges
current_profile_snapshot.phrase_behavior: long lyrical phrases with pickups, breath, delayed resolutions and spacious turnarounds
current_profile_snapshot.harmony_behavior: extended jazz harmony with slow harmonic rhythm, altered dominants and substitutions as controlled options
current_profile_snapshot.bass_behavior: sparse roots/tenths/walking fragments; bass avoids overcrowding
current_profile_snapshot.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: brushes or very light kit; cymbal swells and fills used selectively
current_profile_snapshot.instrument_role_behavior: piano/electric piano, bass, brushes, sax/trumpet/clarinet/flute or guitar lead
current_profile_snapshot.ensemble_player_behavior: ensemble follows melody breath and rubato; accompaniment thins under exposed lines
current_profile_snapshot.arrangement_transformation: AABA/ABA/through-composed ballad structures with gradual dynamic arc
current_profile_snapshot.dynamic_behavior: wide soft-to-medium range with intimate swells
current_profile_snapshot.timing_humanization_behavior: shared rubato and laid-back placement tied to phrase
current_profile_snapshot.continuous_performance_control: expression and tempo curves are essential
current_profile_snapshot.sound_effects_intent: warm room/reverb; delay only when stylistically chosen
current_profile_snapshot.mix_prominence_intent: lead intimate and forward; accompaniment soft and uncluttered
current_profile_snapshot.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: prioritize expressive horn/keys voices and continuous control
